content.text: {"headline":"Approve P0: no action needed — predicted 87.0% service level over 14:30-20:00 against an 80% target, at no extra cost.","why":"Absences are high (payments 19 vs usual 2.6, general 10 vs usual 2.4), but most are bus-strike lateness, and payments volume is running 12% below forecast. With no changes, payments is predicted at 82.7% and general at 92.8%, both above the 80% target, with a 3.4% abandon rate. No escalation is flagged.","trade_offs":["P1 (no cost) does worse than doing nothing: 85.4% overall, with payments at 80.1%, right on the target line. It also pulls cross-skilled agents off general.","P3 (INR 768) adds only a little: 87.9% overall, payments 83.3%, abandons 3.2%. Not worth adding chat deflection and agent moves for under one point.","P2 (INR 6,840) gives the most headroom: 94.0% overall, payments 92.1%, abandons 1.3%. It is the best fallback if things worsen.","P4 (INR 6,888) costs slightly more than P2 for slightly less (93.6%), so P2 is the better paid option."],"watch":"Payments has the thinnest margin (82.7% vs 80%). General handle time has run 15% above forecast for the last two intervals. If that continues, or if late agents don't arrive as expected, be ready to switch to P2 overtime for 17:00-20:00."}
